description: base: one static working-agreement line (delegation, parallel-safety, regression-guard) added as context at session startup, /clear and compaction; skips resume and fork, whose history already holds it. No network, no file access. The old per-prompt UserPromptSubmit directive is an opt-in snippet in .claude/settings.hooks.example.json.

hooks.command: echo 'claude-md: Answer small, sequential or same-file tasks inline without subagents, except deliverables a pack specialist owns with its own guardrails, such as marketing copy or a security audit, which go to that specialist. For 10 or more files to read, 3 or more independent parts, or an independent review, run subagents in parallel in one message, each given only the context it needs plus matching REGRESSIONS.md rows and returning a short result. Use relevant skills without being asked. Never edit the same files in parallel. Use workflows or agent teams only when the user asks. For any bug fix, even a pasted snippet, show a failing regression test and a REGRESSIONS.md row. Before calling work done, apply the regression-guard skill.'
